name: payload-required-relationship-with-undefined
hook: When Payload relationship field has required:true, passing undefined in data object still triggers validation failure
body:
In the persist route, contextRef was set to undefined when the referenced document didn't exist. The conversationData object was built with `contextRef,` always present (key in object, value undefined). Payload's required relationship validation runs even when value is undefined — the presence of the key in the data object is sufficient to trigger the required check.

Fix: Use conditional spread to only include the field when it has a truthy value. This pattern should be used whenever a Payload field has required:true and the value may be absent.
why: The previous fix attempted to guard by setting contextRef=undefined when doc doesn't exist, but the object literal always included the key. Payload validates the presence of required fields regardless of undefined value in the data object.
